title: Downstream utility -- does anything USEFUL survive the generated cells
new_sampling: NONE -- everything runs on delivered arrays already on disk

which_sentence_it_changes.current: the paper does not contain a single sentence answering 'is it USEFUL'. Every metric answers 'does it LOOK like'.
which_sentence_it_changes.external_pressure: R3 called this the largest significance gap

block_a_train_on_synthetic_test_on_real.task: train a cell-type classifier on DELIVERED cells only, evaluate on HELD-OUT REAL cells, report per-type F1
block_a_train_on_synthetic_test_on_real.logic: if our Endothelial cells really are Endothelial, a classifier that has only ever seen generated cells should still recognise real ones

controls.ceiling: the same classifier trained on REAL cells
controls.baselines: the same classifier trained on each baseline's delivered cells

classifier_frozen_in_advance.features: cp10k + log1p over all 2000 genes, no gene selection
classifier_frozen_in_advance.why_not_tuned: any tuning after seeing scores would make the comparison between arms meaningless; the same fixed recipe is applied to every arm including the real-cell ceiling

evaluation_split.rule: identical held-out cells for every arm

block_b_differential_expression_recovery.task: rank genes by logFC for 'this type vs the rest' on REAL cells, repeat on DELIVERED cells, compare the two rankings
block_b_differential_expression_recovery.why_it_is_not_W1: W1 and MMD measure how far apart two distributions are. DE measures whether the ANALYTICAL CONCLUSION a biologist would draw is the same.

frozen_in_advance.logFC: log2((mean cp10k of the type + 1) / (mean cp10k of the rest + 1))
frozen_in_advance.rank_statistic: Spearman rank correlation over all 2000 genes
frozen_in_advance.k_is_frozen: k=50 is fixed here, before any DE is computed. Reporting a different k after seeing the result is forbidden.

block_c_intersection_specific.why_it_is_the_most_valuable_one: it translates the theoretical difference between tilt and tilt+FK into a conclusion a biologist can read
task: in REAL data, split Endothelial cells by whether UAP1 (gene index 128) is detected, and characterise how the two groups differ over the OTHER 1999 genes
do the same inside the DELIVERED cells
block_c_intersection_specific.prediction_stated_before_running: pure tilt moves only the UAP1 MARGINAL and destroys the coupling, so its 'positive' cells must be wrong on the remaining genes; tilt+FK preserves the coupling and therefore can be right.
frozen_comparison_statistics: spearman rank correlation between the real and delivered UAP1+ vs UAP1- logFC vectors over the other 1999 genes
top-50 overlap of that same contrast
block_c_intersection_specific.no_post_hoc_statistic: both statistics are fixed here. Running the analysis and then choosing whichever of the two looks better is forbidden.
block_c_intersection_specific.note_on_that_number: computed from REAL training cells only, before any delivered array was opened; recorded here so the positive group size is auditable

reporting_rule: the three blocks are reported independently. A block that fails is reported as a failure; a block that cannot be run for lack of a delivered array is reported as not measured, with the missing input named.
run_discipline: numbers read from json by script, never typed
